standard.decision_rule: a zeroed answer logit after an intervention is a maximal knockout effect at that site
standard.verdict: maximal knockout effect at the zeroed sites

facts: 76 of 76 exactly-zero answer-logit records sit at the final layer of their model.
The models' unembedding has no bias term and the normalization maps an all-zero vector to all zeros, so a final-layer zero-write produces answer_logit == 0.0 by arithmetic regardless of any circuit.

case-6.question: Are the answer_logit == 0.0 records evidence of a circuit-level knockout effect?

output_check.decision_rule: mechanical artifact iff the zeros concentrate at the final layer where RMSNorm(0)=0 feeds a bias-free unembedding
output_check.instrument: mechanism decomposition: which layer, what dose, what the normalization does to an all-zero residual
output_check.verdict: mechanical artifact: an exactly-zero logit is arithmetic (normalized zero vector into bias-free readout), not a measured effect size
